sources.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
sources.description: A composite of challenging evaluations covering reasoning, science, coding, and long-horizon work. Uses the highlighted model set on the public page; the full model dataset requires an API key.
sources.note: Composite index. Includes several benchmarks that also appear separately on this site; it is counted once in the overall score. The public highlighted set can change as models are added.

costMethodology.note: Usage-based weighted cost per Intelligence Index task, including caching, reasoning and fallback models. The audited v4.3.2 task counts and weights are version-guarded; unknown versions are not estimated.

warnings: Intelligence Index v5.0 scores refreshed; task-cost methodology is only verified for v4.3.2, so older costs were not reused.

costCoverage.note: Weighted cost per Intelligence Index task, reconstructed from the source's measured usage, caching and fallback metadata. Not a token-price proxy or an invoice.

sources.name: LiveBench 2.0
sources.description: Contamination-free long-horizon tasks across coding, agentic work, reasoning, browser use, research, and design.
sources.note: The overall score is the weighted category score published by LiveBench. Category tabs use the underlying category scores.

costMethodology.note: Release-matched cost.csv: total model-under-test spend divided by task count, including failures. Excludes fixed starting state and harness helper calls. Category costs use their own tasks.

costCoverage.note: Release-matched total model-under-test spend divided by task count (including failures). Category costs use their own tasks, not the overall task mix.

sources.name: LMArena Text Arena
sources.description: Blind human preference votes on open-ended chat prompts. The score is an Elo-style rating.

costMethodology.note: Cost/Task (P50) is a median, not a mean. P50 is available only in single-benchmark views and is never pooled with means. API Price $/M is never substituted.

costCoverage.note: Reported median (P50) cost per task from the Cost/Task (P50) column (104/419 rows). P50 is available only in single-benchmark views and is never pooled with means; API Price $/M is never substituted.

sources.name: SWE-bench Pro V2
sources.description: Long-horizon software engineering tasks in real repositories, graded by hidden tests.
sources.note: Results are model + coding harness. The best reported harness is used and shown in the model detail.

costMethodology.note: No monetary cost per task matched to the current leaderboard runs was found in the public page payload. Cost limits are not actual spend and are not used.

costCoverage.note: The public leaderboard payload does not publish monetary task cost matched to these runs. Budget caps, API prices and costs from other evaluators are not substituted.

sources.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
sources.description: End-to-end terminal tasks completed by an autonomous agent in a sandbox.
sources.note: Results are model + agent. The best reported agent is used and shown in the model detail.

costMethodology.note: API total_cost_usd divided by n_trials, including failures and repeated tasks. The website's Cost column is total spend, not cost per unique task.

costCoverage.note: Total reported evaluation spend divided by all trial attempts, including failures and repeated tasks. The website's Cost column itself is a run total.

sources.name: Humanity's Last Exam
sources.description: Expert-written questions across mathematics, science, humanities, and other fields.
sources.note: Scaled independently by Scale AI, with confidence intervals where published.

costMethodology.note: No matching task cost is published in the inspected Scale leaderboard payload. Costs from Artificial Analysis's different HLE runs are not borrowed.

costCoverage.note: The public leaderboard payload does not publish monetary task cost matched to these runs. Budget caps, API prices and costs from other evaluators are not substituted.

sources.name: GSO
sources.description: Software optimization tasks measuring whether agents can make real code faster.
sources.note: Best reported OpenHands run is used.

costMethodology.note: The public leaderboard and compute_metrics.json publish scores, median runtime and turns, but no monetary task cost. Runtime and turns are not converted to dollars.

costCoverage.note: The public leaderboard and compute profile do not report monetary cost per task. Median runtime and turns are not dollar-cost proxies.

sources.name: ARC-AGI-3
sources.description: Interactive, novel problem-solving environments designed to test adaptation and agentic reasoning.
sources.note: Semi-private v3 results. Provider-adapter runs and native runs are both considered; the best reported result is shown.

costMethodology.note: The v3 cost field is total run spend. Per-run attempt counts and completeness are not in the feed, and some runs are incomplete; totals are retained but not mislabeled $/task.

costCoverage.note: Run totals are retained for auditing, but not treated as $/task. Some results have incomplete coverage; no uniform denominator is assumed and ARC is excluded from the task-cost frontier.

sources.name: Code Arena — WebDev
sources.description: Blind human preference votes on frontend and full-stack coding tasks.

costMethodology.note: Reported Cost/Task (P50), a median kept separate from benchmark means. P50 is available only in single-benchmark views; API Price $/M is never substituted.

costCoverage.note: Reported median (P50) cost per task from the Cost/Task (P50) column (104/153 rows). P50 is available only in single-benchmark views and is never pooled with means; API Price $/M is never substituted.

sources.name: MCP Atlas
sources.description: Agentic evaluation of tool use through the Model Context Protocol, built by Scale AI.

costMethodology.note: The inspected public leaderboard payload does not publish monetary cost per task for its scored runs. Missing costs remain unknown.

costCoverage.note: The public leaderboard payload does not publish monetary task cost matched to these runs. Budget caps, API prices and costs from other evaluators are not substituted.
